bullets.text: Portfolio contacted (12 months) held steady at 87.5% this week, with WQC at 89.3%, MTL at 87.2% and QCE at 86.8%.
Activities per advisor fell 8.6% to 16.3, and all three districts were lower: MTL 16.1, QCE 16.4 and WQC 16.2.
Outbound calls fell 12.7% to 1,578 this week, while booked appointments rose 14.4% to 421.
Appointment conversion fell 14.4% to 19.1% in MTL, but rose 34.0% to 25.8% in QCE and 31.5% to 33.8% in WQC.
Show rate in WQC fell 1.2% to 92.2%, the lowest of the three districts, while MTL stood at 97.3%.
